notes: Rust rebuilt for edition 2024: every example and exercise now compiles with rustc --edition 2024, including unsafe extern "C" blocks and the new rule that each unsafe operation inside an unsafe fn needs its own unsafe block
17 new Rust lessons that take the course all the way from beginner to professional, across three new units

New "Thinking in Rust" lessons: files, paths and safe I/O (refusing path traversal); time and dates built from scratch with the standard library; and what's new in recent Rust and edition 2024 (let-chains, LazyLock, get_disjoint_mut, extract_if, is_none_or)

New "Advanced Rust" lessons: writing your own async executor to see how futures, polling and wakers really work; calling C with FFI; procedural (derive) macros; parsing untrusted input safely; measuring allocations with a custom global allocator; and serialization the serde way

New "Working like a pro" unit for Rust: Cargo versions and features, workspaces, a tiny clippy, CI annotations, command-line parsing like clap, logging and RUST_LOG, a small HTTP service, and shipping release builds with cargo audit
Every Rust exercise now has tests proven to reject common wrong answers, and every lesson has a "Common mistakes" note
